name: Semaglutide
description: Man-made version of GLP-1, a gut hormone, with 94% of its sequence shared with human GLP-1

note.text: FDA says the semaglutide shortage ended in Feb 2025. Ozempic and Rybelsus are approved for diabetes; weight use of them is off-label.

bullets: **Label:** binds and activates the GLP-1 receptor, the target of native GLP-1
**GLP-1** regulates appetite; its receptor is in brain appetite areas
**In animals,** it reached and activated neurons that regulate food intake
**Heart-risk mechanism** in adults has not been established (label)
Trials funded by the maker, Novo Nordisk

practical.routes: Injection under the skin; tablets by mouth
practical.pharmacokinetics: Injection: peak 1 to 3 days; tablets: peak 1 hour (label)
practical.soldAs: Prescription (Wegovy, Ozempic, Rybelsus); compounded not approved
practical.monitored: Heart rate, kidney function, blood sugar in diabetes

regulatory.text: Approved; boxed warning, thyroid C-cell tumors

references: N Engl J Med, STEP 1 (Wilding et al.), Mar 2021
